frozen_implementation_checkpoint.note: Includes durable semantic checkpoint/context serialization, wait/wake semantics, generation fencing, objective validation, decomposition/escalation discipline, and regression coverage.

run_state.completion_rule: objective validator evidence required; worker self-assertion is insufficient

allowed_inputs: bounded context packet generated from current state
exact evidence references explicitly named by the run state
forbidden_inputs: full prior chat transcript by default
required_output: TOO_LARGE vs INTRINSICALLY_DIFFICULT disposition when applicable

evaluator_isolation.reason: The authoring session has seen evaluator-only truth and is therefore contaminated for scored model-arm execution.
evaluator_isolation.claim_ceiling: Pilot results may validate workflow mechanics and comparative behavior only; no frontier-equivalence claim may rely on a worker that inspected evaluator-only truth.

B_instant_persistent_chat.continuity: single clean persistent session with durable checkpoints

C_instant_stateless_resume.continuity: fresh clean session each reasoning quantum

D_instant_decompose_critic.continuity: fresh clean workers for decomposition, leaves, critic, synthesis

E_hybrid_escalation.continuity: stateless lower-tier workers plus explicit residual escalation

hard_gates: zero model polling while waiting externally
all COMPLETE states carry passing objective validator evidence
all frontier escalations carry lower-tier evidence and explicit residual reason
next_action: Launch clean model sessions for arms A-E against the frozen public fixture without exposing evaluator-only oracle state; persist every quantum to the run-state paths and evaluate terminal submissions through the deterministic harness.
